title: BENCHHUB: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Holistic and Customizable LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using aggregated multiple-choice and question-answering benchmark datasets (such as BBQ, KoBBQ, DiversityMedQA, and KoSBi) categorized under the 'Bias' subject within the Social Intelligence domain to measure deviations in judgment.

Classifying benchmark queries by specific cultural targets (e.g., Korean vs. General) and evaluating models on culturally specific datasets to measure understanding and performance disparities across different geographical and cultural contexts.
